**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/27 (Sat) 21:49  
[EVENT] User recently got a snake plant about 2 weeks ago.  
[EVENT] User recently repotted their spider plant about 3 weeks ago.  
[CHANGE] User's spider plant is thriving in its new pot and has started producing new baby plants.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Congratulations on your new snake plant and the success with your spider plant!  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Snake plants (Sansevieria Trifasciata) are known for their low-maintenance and adaptability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Check the soil moisture by sticking your finger into the soil about 1-2 inches deep.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Water sparingly; snake plants prefer to dry out slightly between waterings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Water thoroughly, ensuring water flows out of the drainage holes in the pot.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Let the pot drain thoroughly after watering to prevent waterlogged soil.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Adjust watering for the season: less during winter (October to March) and more during the growing season (April to September).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] General watering guideline: every 1-2 weeks during spring and summer, every 3-4 weeks during fall and winter.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provide bright, indirect light and maintain a comfortable room temperature between 65°F to 75°F (18°C to 24°C).  
[EVENT] User inquired about fertilizing their snake plant.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Use a balanced, water-soluble fertilizer with a balanced N-P-K ratio (20-20-20 or 10-10-10) for snake plants.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Fertilize during the growing season (spring and summer) every 4-6 weeks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Dilute the fertilizer to half the recommended strength before applying.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Water thoroughly the day before fertilizing to ensure the soil is moist.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Avoid over-fertilizing, as snake plants are sensitive to it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] If using a succulent fertilizer, dilute it according to the instructions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For variegated snake plant varieties, consider a fertilizer high in phosphorus (P) for healthy leaf growth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Repot every 2-3 years to refresh the soil and provide essential nutrients.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Prune regularly to maintain shape and encourage healthy growth.  
[EVENT] User asked about pruning their snake
